 Order
With the consent of the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

2.This appeal has been filed by the appellants under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicle Act against the award dated 06.09.2019 passed in MACC No.425/2018 by Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sagar seeking setting aside of impugned award and for grant of suitable compensation.

entities.text: Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that in the instant case, deceased was aged 12 years and Tribunal has applied multiplier of 15 in the case where as multiplier of 18 should have been applied.
On above grounds, it is urged that suitable compensation be awarded.

4. Heard. Perused the record of the case.
5.
Sole issue involved in the appeal relates to applicability of multiplier, this case relates to death of a child, who was 12 years, at the time of accident.
In Meena Devi Vs. Nunu Chand Mahto (2023) 1 SCC 204, a case of 12 years old child, multiplier of 15 was applied.

entities.text: Meena Devi Vs. Nunu Chand Mahto (2023) 1 SCC 204
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Hence, in this Court's opinion, Tribunal has applied correct multiplier.
Therefore, findings recorded by the Tribunal are just and proper.
7. Accordingly, appeal filed by the appellants is dismissed.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Hashmi Mukesh vs Neetesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7937920/
